newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks plunge as investors stay out.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks plunge as investors stay out.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended down for the fifth straight session on Tuesday as investors stayed out owing to continued political and economic uncertainty, dealers said.
"The new government has yet to come out with its economic policies and investors are in a wait-and-see mood," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "Trading has shrunk during the last few sessions."
But another dealer, Mohammad Iqbal, said he expected a turnaround in the near term on short-covering by speculators."
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 18.24 points, or 1.12 percent, to end at 1,617.17.
Losers led gainers 295 to 36. Turnover fell to 40 million shares from 60 million on Monday.
Hub Power Co fell 0.85 to 39.25, ICI Pakistan 0.75 to 25.95, Dewan Salman Fibre 2.0 to 42, Adamjee Insuarnce 7.50 to 99 and Engro Chemicals 4.0 to 174. PTCL rose 0.15 to 30.50.
